episodes.title: Lagos Police Crack Down on Aiye Cult | Nigeria News
episodes.description: Lagos police strike hard against the Aiye Confraternity, arresting four key members—including a former chairman—in Mushin and Aganran, seizing a locally made Beretta pistol and ammo. The bust, triggered by one suspect's confession, led to three more arrests who claim the weapon came from a top figure named Rilwan. All four are now in custody aiding the probe as authorities vow to root out cult-related crime and urge the public to report suspicious activity. episodes.title: Ekiti Police Arrest Suspect in Cult Probe | Nigeria News
episodes.description: Ekiti State Police arrest a 26-year-old man in Efon-Ekiti linked to cult activity, seizing a homemade shotgun with live ammo and his phone—prompted by a tip, the case is now under state CID investigation as authorities vow to crack down on threats to public safety and urge community vigilance.
